derivation.max_valid_trials: full planned grid: 3 distances (1/3/5 m) x 3 yaw (-45/0/+45 deg) x 1 pitch x 1 locked lighting variant x 2 poses (standing/seated) x 8 repetitions = 144 matched-pair trials
derivation.matched_pair_semantics: On valid trials the physical control detection rate is 1.0 BY CONSTRUCTION (split_valid_invalid keeps only control-detected trials). The paired risk difference therefore equals 1 - candidate_rate and its interval derives from the candidate-rate bootstrap (trial_statistics._bootstrap_risk_difference_interval). This semantics applies HERE in the P1 physical path, unlike D2-0005 where it was inapplicable.
derivation.frozen_before_data: This file is preregistered: it must be committed before the first P1 garment capture and may not be edited after data collection begins.

invalid_condition_rule: Control-undetected trials are invalid measurement conditions, never candidate successes; they are accounted via invalid_condition_report and excluded from valid_trials.
